title_en: In the heart of Tirana, Apartment 3+1+2 for rent! 39-story tower! Blvd. "New"
description_en: Tirana New Boulevard Tower, Apartment 3+1+2 for rent! 39-story tower! Description: Located along the New Boulevard of Tirana, part of the historical north-south axis of the city; Connects Skënderbej square with the river of Tirana, positioning it as a key urban node; Close to Central Park and part of the River Project Master Plan; The colorful facade is inspired by the eclectic materials of Tirana; Textured surfaces and shades that change with the light, creating a dynamic visual effect; Integrates green roofs and energy-efficient design for a sustainable approach; Apartments organized around a central core; Continuous wrap-around balconies for expansive views and natural light; The three upper levels offer penthouses with panoramic views of Central Park and beyond. Technical information: * 10th (tenth) floor (9+) * Total area: 150.5 m2 * Net area: 112 m2 ► The apartment consists of: - living room; - cooking environment; - 3 bedrooms - 2 bathrooms - Possibility of a parking space at an extra price! Strategic Position! This project seems to embody Tirana's ambition to develop as a European metropolis with a strong architectural and urban identity! For more information on the project, contact me!
